benchmarkDenominator.source: Shallow sparse upstream checkout in .upstream-cache/readability at commit 08be6b4bdb204dd333c9b7a0cfbc0e730b257252; counted package.json test runner, test/test-*.js harnesses, and test/test-pages fixture directories.

runnerStatus.reason: The full upstream runner could not execute in the sparse cache because dependencies were not installed. Probe command `npm test` reached the package script `mocha test/test-*.js` and failed before running tests with `sh: line 1: mocha: command not found`. Installing upstream npm dependencies was deferred to keep this lane slice modest.

benchmarkDenominator.warning: This replaces the seed denominator with a cloned static inventory, not upstream runner parity. Native PHP progress maps 7 focused lane tests against a 1984-test upstream Mocha denominator.

nativeImplementation.currentSlice: Native DOM extractor removes chrome and unlikely candidates, scores semantic content containers, implements Mozilla-style isProbablyReaderable thresholds, and emits simple WordPress blocks.

wordpressScenario: Migration-aware article cleanup into clean WordPress blocks with page-builder navigation, comment widgets, share UI, and surrounding theme chrome removed.
